title: Sharing Is Caring variation
author: Nicholas Rockstroh
problems: Row 4 "pull by right diagonal robins" can't start from where the dancers are: Nobody here faces anyone to dance with.
Row 9 "balance & box circulate - robins cross while larks loop left · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 is not standing in a side line.
Row 11 "balance & Rory O'More left to partner · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Neighbors in a wave must face opposite ways.
Row 11 "balance & Rory O'More left to partner · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Neighbors in a wave must face opposite ways.
Row 9 "balance & box circulate - robins cross while larks loop left · box circulate" can't start from where the dancers are: The dancers who cross must face in across the set.
Row 11 "balance & Rory O'More left to partner · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers are not in a straight line.
Row 11 "balance & Rory O'More left to partner · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers are not in a straight line.
Row 12 "partners long swing" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0's partner is outside the group.
choices: Rory O'More spins one full turn in the travel direction.
The balance before each Rory steps toward the slide direction first.
A long swing is drawn as an ordinary swing.
Long waves form during the balance before each box circulate: crossers face in, loopers face out; hands join only where they reach.
